Presenting 2nd LaserHacks 2026 – Hack the Future

Presenting The 2nd LaserHack Hackathon, an exciting innovation marathon organized by the SCRS Chapter at Lasell University, USA on October 17-18, 2026. 2nd LaserHack 2026 invites students, professionals, and tech enthusiasts to ideate, build, and showcase transformative solutions to global challenges.

This hackathon is your launchpad to experiment with emerging technologies, collaborate with brilliant minds, and create impact-driven prototypes. Whether you're a seasoned developer, a design thinker, or a curious learner, LaserHacks offers a space to innovate, grow, and connect.

Hackathon Themes

Participants are free to choose a specific problem within any of the following domains:

  • Artificial Intelligence (AI)
  • Cybersecurity
  • Image Processing
  • Blockchain & FinTech
  • HealthTech
  • AR/VR & Metaverse
  • EdTech & E-Learning
  • Web3 & DApps

 Eligibility

  • This competition is open to all university students (undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral), working professionals, and technology enthusiasts.
  • No restrictions on age, background, or specialization.
  • Participants from Engineering, Design, Business, Sciences, and other disciplines are welcome.

 Team Formation

  • Teams of 2–4 members are mandatory.
  • Inter-college / Inter-organization teams: Allowed and encouraged
  • Inter-specialization teams: Highly encouraged for diverse perspectives

 Competition Format & Rounds

Round 1: Idea Submission https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdk4AmERzvkCroKjJHPZorArhHLWR6eC7HFF0p_kdPt6VCYfw/viewform

  • Submit a 2-page PDF/ PPT detailing:
    • Problem statement and chosen theme
    • Proposed solution and unique features
    • Technology stack
    • Real-world impact and feasibility
  • Evaluation based on innovation, clarity, feasibility, and relevance.
  • Shortlisted teams advance to Round 2.

Round 2: Prototype Development & Final Presentation

  • Build a working prototype or MVP.
  • Finalists present live (virtually) to an expert jury from academia and industry.

Rules & Regulations

  • Maintain a respectful, inclusive environment. Misconduct leads to disqualification.
  • All work must be original and created during the hackathon.
  • Open-source tools and APIs are allowed with proper attribution.
  • Teams retain full IP rights. Organizers may showcase projects for non-commercial promotion.
  • Late submissions will not be evaluated.
  • Judging Criteria:
    • Innovation & Creativity
    • Impact & Relevance
    • Technical Implementation
    • UX/UI Design
    • Presentation & Communication
  • Organizers may revise rules/timelines with prior notice.

Rewards & Prizes

  • Winner: $ 750
  • First Runner-Up: $ 500
  • Second Runner-Up: $ 250
  • Finalists: Certificates of Recognition

Timeline & Duration

 Hackathon Dates: 17-18 October 2026 (2 days)
 Registration Deadline: 12 October 2026

Have Questions?

Reach out to us at vmanjunath@lasell.edu or scrs@lasell.edu

Note:

LaserHack Registration Deadlines
We will accept registrations through Unstop by October 12, while participants can register themselves through the LaserHack website until October 15. 

"Registration is on a first-come, first-served basis and will close once capacity is reached."
